name: Punjabi (Gurmukhi)
caution: 5.4 million words, versus hundreds of millions for the main languages. Frequency values are unreliable, so there are no frequency bands, only the all-words generators. The reference lexicon has 33,016 words, so generators, neighbourhood measures and cluster filters are rougher than for the main languages. 33,016 of the reference words come from a Wikipedia corpus (Leipzig Corpora Collection, pan_wikipedia_2021_300K, 5.4 million words); no subtitle list exists for this language. Written sources are more formal than subtitles and contain more names and foreign words. All frequencies come from that corpus, so no frequency bands are offered. Punjabi (Gurmukhi) is an abugida: CV (orthographic) counts every consonant letter as C plus an inherent vowel V unless a vowel sign or virama follows; tippi and bindi are C before a consonant; addak (gemination) counts as C. CV (phonological) applies the schwa-deletion rule (Hindi-type; not checked against pronunciations). Length is counted in aksharas.
source: Leipzig Corpora Collection word list pan_wikipedia_2021_300K (CC BY; Goldhahn, Eckart & Quasthoff 2012)
reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: number of training words, between 5000 and 40000

cv_guess.method: schwa-deletion rule (Ohala 1983: inherent vowel dropped word-finally and in V C _ C V, right to left), overridden by a 3-character context table learned from the IPA-annotated words where it is consistent; evaluated on a held-out 20%
cv_guess.note: too few IPA words to evaluate; rule-based defaults dominate

patches.what: removed 3516 bank items that occur as a form (any count or capitalisation) in the Leipzig list pan_wikipedia_2021_300K
